name: Mia
summary: A dice bluffing game where players must announce increasingly higher rolls and challenge suspected liars.
rules_text: Each player has 6 lives. On a turn a player rolls two dice hidden under a cup and must announce a result. The rank order from high to low is 21 (Mia), 66,55,44,33,22,11,65,64,63,62,61,54,53,52,51,43,42,41,32,31 where the higher die is tens. The announced value may be true or a bluff and must be >= previous announcement, except after first roll. The next player has two options: believe and roll, then announce a value >= previous without necessarily revealing the new roll, or call the previous player a liar and lift the cup. If the hidden roll is less than the announcement the announcer loses a life, otherwise the challenger loses. If Mia (21) is announced the next player may concede one life or look: if it is 21 they lose two lives, otherwise the announcer loses one. Play proceeds clockwise. First to lose all lives loses and game ends.
